issue_context.title: ES|QL: NullPointerException on stats avg()
issue_context.body:
Reproduces more or less deterministically on https://demo.elastic.co

```
POST _query
{
  "query":"from metrics-* | stats avg(event.duration) | limit 10"
}
```

```
Caused by: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "org.elasticsearch.index.mapper.MappedFieldType.typeName()" because "fieldType" is null
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.stats.SearchStats.detectSingleValue(SearchStats.java:185)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.stats.SearchStats.lambda$isSingleValue$10(SearchStats.java:168)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.stats.SearchStats.doWithContexts(SearchStats.java:283)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.stats.SearchStats.isSingleValue(SearchStats.java:167)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.optimizer.LocalPhysicalPlanOptimizer$PushStatsToSource.lambda$pushableStats$0(LocalPhysicalPlanOptimizer.java:379)
	at java.util.Map.computeIfAbsent(Map.java:1066)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.optimizer.LocalPhysicalPlanOptimizer$PushStatsToSource.pushableStats(LocalPhysicalPlanOptimizer.java:364)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.optimizer.LocalPhysicalPlanOptimizer$PushStatsToSource.rule(LocalPhysicalPlanOptimizer.java:331)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.optimizer.LocalPhysicalPlanOptimizer$PushStatsToSource.rule(LocalPhysicalPlanOptimizer.java:323)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.optimizer.PhysicalOptimizerRules$ParameterizedOptimizerRule.lambda$apply$0(PhysicalOptimizerRules.java:37)

```

review_comments: Quite likely - the default is MV (false) but this breaks the bitwise logic which was copied over for consistency.

I guess it's safe to assume that there will be at least one valid MappedFieldType, and if the type allows MV it will be set to `false` anyway.
Or maybe there are situations where none of the contexts has a MappedFieldType for that specific field, and in that case we still want to fall back to `false`?
